claims.statement: The `docs` Python CLI is registered as a project script entry point at `pipeline.cli:main` in `pyproject.toml`, making it available as `uv run pipeline <command>` or (after installation) as `docs <command>`.

`docs dev` orchestrates development by: (1) optionally performing an initial full build via `build_command()`, (2) starting a `FileWatcher` monitoring `src/` for changes and triggering incremental rebuilds, and (3) launching the Mintlify dev server (`mint dev --port 3000`) in the `/build` directory with log forwarding, then continuing to watch until interrupted or a process exits abnormally.

`docs build` reads documentation from `src/`, validates the directory exists, creates the `/build` directory if needed, and uses `DocumentationBuilder` to preprocess files and copy them to `/build`, returning exit code 0 on success or 1 on failure.

`docs mv <old_path> <new_path>` discovers the Git root and scans `<root>/src` `.md`, `.mdx`, and `.ipynb` documentation content to rewrite relative cross-references to the moved file; it preserves anchors, recalculates internal relative links in the moved Markdown/MDX file or notebook, and supports `--dry-run` previews without writes.

The built-site link targets run Mintlify from `build/` after a build; they filter deployment-generated OpenAPI and standalone-snippet noise and fail only when remaining output contains reported link entries. The anchor variant adds `--check-anchors`.

The code-snippets target runs extraction before MDX generation: extraction reads supported marked source samples under `src/code-samples/` into `src/code-samples-generated/`, then generation writes importable MDX under `src/snippets/code-samples/`.

`make update-code-sample-traces` runs selected samples with `CODE_SAMPLE_TRACING=1`, defaults the LangSmith project to `docs-code-samples`, then regenerates snippet MDX; publishing trace links requires `LANGSMITH_API_KEY`.

The executable sample runner dispatches eligible Python, TypeScript, Go, shell, Java, and Kotlin files through their language-specific toolchains, preserves the caller environment for credentials and services, retries only detected LangSmith rate limits up to five times by default with configurable backoff, and treats a persistently rate-limited sample as skipped rather than failed.

`make broken-links`, `make broken-links-with-anchors`, `make check-openapi`, and `make export` declare the phony `build` target as a prerequisite, so each rebuilds the generated tree before its Mint operation; `make htmltest` has no build prerequisite and validates an existing `EXPORT_ZIP` instead.

`scripts/check_llms_urls.py` validates deployed rather than locally generated LLM indexes: it crawls the root `llms.txt` and nested indexes, compares reachable page URLs with the deployed sitemap, and exits 1 after reporting sitemap pages missing from the index; `--base-url` selects the served site to check.

`DocumentationBuilder.build_all()` removes and recreates the build directory before producing versioned and unversioned documentation, copying shared files and npm snippet components; a full build therefore discards manual build-tree changes.

`docs migrate` recursively selects notebooks, Markdown, and `.markdown` files, while `docs migrate-docusaurus` also selects MDX; conversion can print rather than write with `--dry-run`, and a parse failure is recorded per file so a batch continues.

`scripts/check_onboarding_models.py` reads configured onboarding snippet files from GitHub or a `--repo-dir` checkout, reports model IDs not current for their provider without editing them, and exits 0 when current, 1 when stale IDs are found, or 2 when its registry or inputs cannot be read.

`make export` checks for the Mint export command and rejects Node 25 or newer before exporting from `build/`; it documents Node 20 or 22 and an Enterprise Mintlify plan as prerequisites, while `make htmltest` requires an existing zip plus `htmltest` and `unzip`.

`docs mv` also updates safe site-absolute routes in documentation and `src/docs.json` navigation entries and redirect destinations, while leaving redirect sources unchanged; ambiguous versioned route forms or forms lacking an equivalent destination are warned about and left unchanged.

`make lint` runs Ruff formatting and lint checks, `ty`, and `codespell src`; `make format` applies Ruff fixes, `make format-check` is non-mutating, and `make test` runs pytest with network sockets disabled except Unix sockets.
`.mise.toml` defines the local Node 22, Python 3.13, uv 0.9.26, Vale 3.17.1, prek, and Mint CLI tool baseline; its postinstall hook installs prek's pre-commit and pre-push hooks.

TypeScript code samples use the separate `src/code-samples/package.json` manifest and committed lockfile version 3 at `src/code-samples/package-lock.json`, not the root-site dependency manifest; the Make sample targets install that package's dependencies before TypeScript samples run through `npx tsx` from `src/code-samples/`. Python samples use the root uv project, and Go samples resolve `src/code-samples/go.mod`.
`make check-mdx` rebuilds the generated tree, asks Mint to validate only unknown components and foreign syntax without rebuilding, and exits nonzero when parsed JSON diagnostics are present.

`make install` synchronizes all uv dependency groups, installs root npm dependencies and Mint globally with up to three attempts, then links repository skills; `make skills` preserves existing non-symlink entries and removes only stale skill symlinks.
